description: Input/output contract for the v3 fail-closed Uniswap V3 LP-flow monitor. The threshold pct=0.01 is INHERITED from the v2 descriptive characterization and has NOT been re-validated under v3's net-replenishment rule (a v3 re-characterization is pending).

rules.date: parseable date; unique; ascending as given; strictly consecutive calendar days (no gaps); emitted as 'date' by the v3 SQL
rules.n_unpriced_legs: finite; must equal EXACTLY 0 on every day (any non-zero value, including negative, -> DATA_ERROR)
rules.pool: if pool_address/pool_label/pool is present, it must hold exactly one distinct value
rules.window: at least MIN_WINDOW_DAYS (14) rows; shorter windows -> DATA_ERROR (insufficient history)

input.parameter_pct: the detector's pct argument must be a finite, positive number (else ValueError)

baseline_semantics: Leakage for day i compares |net_i| to the mean of POSITIVE gross-inflow days in the up-to-7 prior calendar days (a partial, left-truncated window near the start). With no positive-inflow day in the lookback the baseline is 0 and the relative rule is skipped for day i. The first ~7 days act as warm-up.
